meaning: When true, only wallets in `allowed_callers` may open calls on the model.
Callers allowed to open calls when `allow_list_enabled` is true, up to 32 unique addresses.
Maximum calls per caller inside one `window_slots` window. `0` (with `window_slots = 0`) disables rate limits.
Rate-limit window length in slots. Must be `0` when `max_calls_per_caller_per_window` is `0`, and positive otherwise.
Enclave operators allowed to receive grants for this model, up to 16 unique addresses. Empty means any operator.
Allowed region codes, up to 8 unique codes of 1 to 16 lowercase letters, digits or hyphens each. Empty means any region.
The slot the policy was last created or updated in.
